name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Owning the relationship after the sale and proving value well before renewal is the work I'm best at. Helping government agencies serve the public faster and more simply is a mission I'd be glad to put that toward.

At Birdeye I managed 15 to 20 reseller partners and retained all but one, roughly 94%, by watching utilization and performance data for risk, stepping in with remediation before frustration became cancellation, and escalating the right issues to Product and Engineering. At Wix I onboarded 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets while leading a team of onboarding specialists. At Accelo I built trusted relationships with C-suite clients and raised account risk early. Across those roles I've run business reviews, managed escalations, and represented the company at tradeshows and customer meetings, and I document everything so plans, commitments, and next steps are always current.

I haven't sold to or supported government agencies yet, and I'd expect to learn how municipal and county customers buy and renew quickly. I'd welcome a conversation about the accounts this role would own.
